bug_description.original: Container-overflow WRITE 4 in poppler::page::text_list. Crash State: poppler::page::text_list pdf_fuzzer.cc. Sanitizer: address (ASAN). Recommended Security Severity: High.
bug_description.normalized: In poppler::page::text_list, when the text_list_include_font flag is set, a text_box_font_info_data struct is created with glyph_to_cache_index initialized as an empty vector. The code calls reserve(word->getLength()) which allocates backing storage but leaves the vector's logical size at 0. It then iterates via a loop bounded by word->getLength() and uses operator[] to write at index j, which writes past the container's logical boundary. ASan detects this as a container-overflow WRITE of size 4. The fix replaces operator[] with push_back() so the vector's size is properly updated.

source.description: Materializes the text word list from the rendered PDF page content. The words' existence and glyph counts (word->getLength()) drive the loop iteration that reaches the container-overflow write.
source.value_from: Attacker-controlled PDF page content rendered by displayPageSlice into TextOutputDev, then extracted as text words by makeWordList

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: operator[] writes 4 bytes (int value -1) at index j in glyph_to_cache_index whose logical size is 0 (only capacity was set by reserve()), causing a container-overflow WRITE past the vector's logical end.

root_cause.description: Uses operator[] to write to glyph_to_cache_index at index j, but the vector's size is 0 because only reserve() was called rather than resize() or push_back(). operator[] does not check or update the vector's size, resulting in a write past the container's logical boundary. The fix replaces this with push_back(-1).

tainted_value_origin.note: Word list materialized from rendered PDF page content. word->getLength() >= 1 from attacker PDF drives the glyph iteration loop at line 463 to at least one iteration, reaching the vulnerable operator[] access at line 478.

parser_admitted.description: displayPageSlice renders the attacker-controlled PDF page content into the TextOutputDev; a valid-enough PDF page with text content is required for makeWordList to produce a non-empty word list.

font_info_guard.description: The guard 'if (tb_font_info && d->font_info_cache_initialized)' must be true to enter the block containing reserve() and the inner glyph loop. tb_font_info is non-null when opt_flag includes text_list_include_font (step 2), and font_info_cache_initialized is set by init_font_info_cache() at line 443.

fine_trace.note: Materializes the text word list from the rendered PDF page. The crafted PDF contains at least one page with text, producing a non-null word_list with getLength() >= 1, so the outer word processing loop at line 423 is entered. displayPageSlice at line 411 rendered the page content into the TextOutputDev beforehand.
The caller (pdf_fuzzer) passes text_list_include_font, so this condition is true and the font-info collection path is entered. Without this flag, the vulnerable code at line 478 is unreachable.

depends_on.via: word_list->getLength() > 0 so outer loop at line 423 iterates

fine_trace.note: glyph_to_cache_index is aggregate-initialized as an empty std::vector<int> within the text_box_font_info_data struct (size=0, capacity=0).

Calls reserve() with word->getLength(), which allocates backing storage (capacity >= word->getLength()) but does NOT change the vector's logical size, which remains 0. This creates the precondition for the container overflow: memory is physically allocated past the logical end, but the vector still reports size()=0.

depends_on.via: word->getLength() derived from attacker-controlled PDF text content

fine_trace.note: Uses operator[] to write int value -1 (4 bytes) at index j=0 in glyph_to_cache_index. The loop at line 463 iterates with condition j < word->getLength(), not j < glyph_to_cache_index.size(). Since the vector's logical size is 0 (only capacity was set by reserve() at step 4), this writes past the container's logical boundary into reserved-but-uncommitted storage. ASan detects this as container-overflow WRITE of size 4. The fix replaces this statement with push_back(-1), which properly appends and increments the vector's size.

depends_on.via: glyph_to_cache_index has capacity >= word->getLength() from reserve() but logical size remains 0
inner loop at line 463 iterates because word->getLength() >= 1

poc.trigger: Feed the crafted 16297-byte PDF file to pdf_fuzzer, which loads it via load_from_raw_data, creates pages, and calls text_list(text_list_include_font) on each page

format.name: PDF
format.contract: A crafted PDF file containing at least one page with text content that produces at least one TextWord with getLength() >= 1 when rendered and extracted via makeWordList, triggering the font-info collection path
